story.en: OSM places this reconstructed route from Danlugan ni Ina through Panganiban, Colgante and Magsaysay bridges to Dagsaan near the Basilica. This sequence is inferred; the eyewitness source records passage under Colgante. The 16:00–18:00 replay, 120 follower boats, 16 escorts and riverside crowds are illustrative; spectators line both banks, off the bridge decks, as the project owner asked on 2026-10-08. About 1.5 million attended in 2024; river conditions moved the 2026 departure to 21:00.

sources.note: September 20, 2026: Dagsaan landing near the Basilica, about 1.2 million spectators. The night schedule differs from the illustrative afternoon replay.
